posts.content:
Introduction to Etihad Town

 
Etihad Town is one of Lahore’s premier real estate developments, offering modern living and excellent Lahore property investment opportunities. Known for its state-of-the-art infrastructure, lush green parks, and commercial hubs, Etihad Town has become a preferred choice for investors and homebuyers alike. With a commitment to quality and convenience, the project caters to both residential and commercial needs.
   

About Etihad Town Phase 2

 
Phase 2 of Etihad Town offers a range of Etihad Town Phase 2 plots ideal for families and investors alike. Strategically designed with modern urban planning principles, Phase 2 offers a blend of residential plots, commercial spaces, and premium amenities. This phase is designed to provide a comfortable lifestyle while promising high investment returns.
   

Achievements of Etihad Town Phase 2

 
Etihad Town Phase 2 has quickly gained popularity due to several factors:
 
Modern Infrastructure: Roads, parks, and utilities built to international standards.
Commercial Hubs: Strategic Pine Avenue commercial plots increase connectivity and investment value for buyers in Phase 2.
High Demand: Prime location and top-notch amenities make plots highly sought-after.
Investor Confidence: Regular updates and transparent dealings have built trust in the market.
  Etihad Town Phase 2 Development
    https://youtu.be/y2Er7h2dMaE    

Strategic Location & Easy Connectivity of Etihad Town Phase 2

 
With easy access to main roads and city hubs, Etihad Town Phase 2 is a top choice for Lahore property investment. Its connectivity ensures residents and businesses reach important destinations quickly. Nearby schools, hospitals, shopping centers, and entertainment zones make it ideal for families and entrepreneurs alike.
    https://youtu.be/yrfF2NB7wNk      

Previous Installment Plan of Etihad Town Phase 2 

 
Previously, Etihad Town Phase 2 offered a 3-year payment plan. While flexible, buyers had to wait longer to fully own their property. The original plan included:
 
  • 20% down payment
  • 30% during development milestones
  • Remaining 50% in monthly installments over 3 years
 
Some investors preferred a faster payment schedule to minimize long-term financial commitments and seize investment opportunities sooner.
   

Etihad Town Phase 2: Now with a 2.5-Year Payment Plan

 
Responding to market demand, Etihad Town has revised the Phase 2 payment plan to 2.5 years. The new 2.5-year payment plan makes buying Etihad Town Phase 2 plots faster and more convenient for investors. 
 

Key highlights include:

 
  • Reduced installment duration: 2.5 years instead of 3 years
  • Flexible payment options to suit different budgets
  • Faster property ownership and possession timeline
   

Reasons Behind the Reduced Payment Plan

 
The decision to reduce the payment plan duration was influenced by:
 
Market Demand: Investors prefer quicker returns and faster ownership.
 
Competitive Advantage: Shorter plans attract more buyers in Lahore’s real estate market.
 
Customer Convenience: Reduces long-term financial commitments and simplifies investment.
   

Benefits of the Revised Payment Plan

 
The 2.5-year payment plan offers multiple advantages:
 
Faster Property Possession: Complete payments sooner and start construction or leasing quickly.
 
Enhanced Investment Returns: Early ownership allows buyers to benefit from property value appreciation.
 
Flexible Payment Options: Structured installments make finances easier for families and investors.
 
Peace of Mind: Shorter payment duration reduces financial stress and ensures a smoother buying experience.
   

More Information for Potential Buyers

 
Etihad Town Phase 2 offers a variety of plot sizes and commercial options:
 
  • Residential plots from 5 marla to 1 kanal
  • Commercial plots in Pine Avenue and other prime locations
  • Access to parks, security, schools, and retail hubs
  • Nearby main roads and city connectivity for convenience
 
Whether you are an investor or a homebuyer, Phase 2 offers long-term capital growth and premium lifestyle opportunities.
   

How Pine Avenue Boosts Connectivity and Value in Etihad Town Phase 2

 
Pine Avenue plays a crucial role in enhancing accessibility and overall appeal. Serving as a central artery, it seamlessly connects residential plots with commercial hubs, retail areas, and key city roads, making commuting and business operations more convenient.
 
Pine Avenue Commercial adds significant investment potential, attracting businesses and boosting the local economy. This connectivity increases livability and contributes to higher property values over time, making Etihad Town Phase 2 an attractive choice for both homeowners and investors.
        https://youtu.be/9E4xneEpuvE  

Unique Features of Etihad Town Phase 2

 
Pine Avenue Commercial: Connects premium business hubs for enhanced investment opportunities
 
Green Spaces: Landscaped parks and jogging tracks promote a healthy lifestyle
 
Secure Environment: Gated community with 24/7 surveillance
 
Modern Amenities: Schools, mosques, retail shops, and recreational areas within the society
   

Why Invest in Etihad Town Phase 2 Now?

 
With rising demand, strong connectivity, and a reduced 2.5-year payment plan, Etihad Town Phase 2 stands out as a smart choice for buyers. Early investment ensures faster ownership, better returns, and long-term value in Lahore’s growing real estate market.
   

Final Thoughts

 
With the payment plan now reduced to 2.5 years, Etihad Town Phase 2 makes property ownership faster, more flexible, and rewarding. Whether you are looking for a home or commercial investment, this phase offers an unmatched combination of location, infrastructure, and financial convenience.
 
Secure your Etihad Town Phase 2 plot today and take advantage of this premium Lahore property investment opportunity.
 
Etihad Marketing is here to guide you! Our expert team provides complete information on plot options, pricing, and investment benefits, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free purchase. Contact us today to secure your ideal residential or commercial plot in Etihad Town Phase 2 before the revised payment plan offer expires.
   

Frequently Asked Questions

The payment plan was revised to meet market demand for faster ownership and improved investment returns. Shorter plans also reduce long-term financial commitments.
   

  1. Is the 2.5-year payment plan available for all plot sizes?

 
Yes, the revised payment plan applies to most residential and commercial plots in Etihad Town Phase 2, subject to availability.
   

  1. Does the reduced payment duration increase installment amounts?

 
Installments may be slightly adjusted, but the plan remains flexible and affordable for both investors and end users.
   

  1. Who should consider investing in Etihad Town Phase 2 now?

 
This plan is ideal for buyers seeking quicker possession, faster returns, and a secure Lahore property investment.
   

  1. Are Pine Avenue commercial plots included in the revised plan?

 
Yes, Pine Avenue commercial plots are part of Phase 2 and benefit from the updated 2.5-year installment schedule.
   

  1. Will earlier completion lead to faster possession?

 
Yes, completing payments sooner can help buyers move closer to possession and construction readiness.
   

  1. Is Etihad Town Phase 2 suitable for long-term investment?

 
Absolutely. Its location, infrastructure, and commercial connectivity ensure strong long-term capital growth.
   

  1. Can overseas Pakistanis benefit from this revised payment plan?

 
Yes, the flexible installment structure makes it convenient for overseas buyers to invest securely from abroad.
   

  1. Does the revised plan affect development progress?

 
No, development continues as planned, with improved timelines supporting faster project completion.
   

  1. Is this 2.5-year payment plan a limited-time offer?

 
Yes, the revised payment plan is time-sensitive, and buyers are advised to secure their plot before the offer expires.

posts.title: Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial Launch - A New Chapter in Lahore’s Business Landscape
posts.excerpt: Etihad Town has firmly established itself as one of Lahore’s most reliable and progressive real estate brands. Over the years, the project has delivered well-planned residential communities, modern infrastructure, and st...
posts.content:
Etihad Town has firmly established itself as one of Lahore’s most reliable and progressive real estate brands. Over the years, the project has delivered well-planned residential communities, modern infrastructure, and strong returns for investors. With successful developments in earlier phases, Etihad Town has earned the trust of both end-users and investors by focusing on timely execution, premium locations, and sustainable urban planning. Its commitment to quality roads, utilities, commercial zones, and lifestyle facilities has positioned Etihad Town as more than just a housing project, it is a growing urban ecosystem designed for modern living and profitable investment.
 
Continuing this journey of excellence, the developer has now introduced its most ambitious commercial venture yet: Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial.
   

Etihad Town Phase 3 – Redefining Commercial Development in Lahore

   
The launch of Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial marks a major milestone in Lahore’s commercial real estate landscape. Designed as a dedicated business destination, this phase is strategically planned around five major business structure roads, creating multiple high-visibility commercial corridors within a single project.
 
These roads include:
 
  • Jhelum Road
  • Chenab Road
  • Shigar Road
  • Pine Avenue Road
  • Jinnah Avenue
  • (Vertical and internal commercial avenues)
   
This multi-road commercial layout ensures smooth traffic flow, maximum frontage, and strong footfall potential and key factors for successful businesses, retailers, and corporate brands.
     

Prime Location & Unmatched Accessibility

   
One of the strongest advantages of Etihad Town Phase 3 is its exceptional connectivity.
 
The upcoming Jhelum Road, a massive 300-foot-wide boulevard, will directly link the project to Lahore Ring Road, offering seamless access from all major parts of the city. This single feature significantly boosts the project’s long-term value, making it ideal for large businesses, corporate offices, showrooms, and high-end commercial developments.
 
In addition, the project is surrounded by major future landmarks including:
 
  • CBD 2 (Central Business District Phase 2) with modern skyscrapers
  • High-rise commercial buildings with no height restrictions
  • Nawaz Sharif Medical Complex, spread over approximately 6,000 kanals, currently under development
   
Such large-scale infrastructure projects guarantee sustained commercial activity, population movement, and demand for retail and business services in the area.
     

Pine Avenue – A Proven Commercial Success Story

   
Pine Avenue Road is already setting benchmarks in commercial success.
 
Launched in November 2025, Pine Avenue commercial plots were completely sold out within just 25 days — a remarkable achievement reflecting strong market confidence. According to development timelines, by March, nearly 100% construction and infrastructure work will be completed.
 
What makes Pine Avenue special is not only its rapid development but also its strong commercial readiness:
 
  • Leading banks, national brands, and fashion outlets are already prepared to establish their presence
  • Investors who purchased early are already witnessing capital appreciation and rising rental demand
  • Business owners planning early construction or rentals are positioned to enjoy first-mover advantages
   
This success has now laid the foundation for the expansion of commercial zones across the entire Phase 3 master plan.
   

Flexible 3-Year Pre-Launch Payment Plans for Commercial Plots

   
To make commercial investment more accessible and investor-friendly, Etihad Town is offering exclusive 3-year pre-launch payment plans for its commercial plots in Phase 3. These flexible plans allow investors and business owners to secure premium locations with manageable monthly or quarterly installments while benefiting from early-stage pricing.
   
The pre-launch options are designed for different investment goals and business scales, covering both general commercial areas and prime structure roads.
   

Commercial Plot – Pre-Launch Payment Plan (General Commercial)

   
This plan is ideal for investors looking to enter Etihad Town Phase 3 at an early stage with affordable pricing and long-term growth potential.
   
Key benefits:
 
  • 3-year easy installment schedule
  • Lower pre-launch rates
  • Suitable for retail shops, offices, and small businesses
  • High future rental demand within the community
   

Commercial Plot – Pre-Launch Payment Plan (300-Ft Wide Jhelum Road)

   
Jhelum Road is the future commercial backbone of Phase 3, directly linked to Ring Road and surrounded by mega developments like CBD 2 and Nawaz Sharif Medical Complex.
 
This plan is perfect for:
 
  • Corporate offices
  • Banks
  • Shopping plazas
  • Large retail brands
  • High-traffic businesses
  • Investment advantages:
  • Location on a 300-ft wide main boulevard
  • Maximum visibility and commercial exposure
  • Ideal for long-term capital appreciation
  • Flexible 3-year installment structure
 

 

Commercial Plot – Pre-Launch Payment Plan (150-Ft Wide Pine Avenue Road)

   
Pine Avenue has already proven its market strength by selling out within weeks of launch. Now, new investors have a chance to secure plots on this premium road through a limited pre-launch payment plan.
   
Why Pine Avenue stands out:
 
  • Sold out previously in 25 days
  • Fast development progress
  • Strong interest from banks and brands
  • High rental yield potential
  • Located on a 150-ft wide commercial road
   
With this plan, investors can enter one of the most in-demand commercial locations in Etihad Town at early pricing with flexible installments.
   

Small Commercial Plots on Installments – A Market First

   
Etihad Town has introduced a unique concept that sets it apart from other developers:
 
Small commercial plots on installments on major structure roads.
 
This initiative opens doors for:
 
  • Small and medium investors
  • Entrepreneurs
  • Shop owners
  • First-time commercial buyers
 
It lowers the entry barrier into premium commercial real estate, making structured-road businesses accessible to a wider market segment, something rarely offered in Lahore’s top commercial projects.
     

Five Business Roads – One Powerful Commercial Hub

 
Etihad Town Phase 3 is designed as a complete commercial network, not just isolated blocks.
 
Key highlights include:
 
  • Commercial zones along Jhelum Road, Pine Avenue, Chenab Road, and Shigar Road
  • Commercial development near a dedicated water park, boosting leisure-based footfall
  • Commercial plots on Jinnah Avenue (150-ft wide road) connecting Bahria Town to Ferozepur Road
  • Commercial opportunities on Pine Vertical Avenue
  • Planned business parks and food courts
  • Well-distributed sector shops for community-level retail needs
   
Together, these elements create a balanced ecosystem of retail, corporate, leisure, and service-based businesses.
     

Tomorrow’s Grand Launch Event – A Vision for the Future

 
The grand launch event of Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial is set to present the developer’s long-term vision for Lahore’s next major business hub.
 
During the event, the management will highlight:
 
  • The transformation of Pine Avenue into a fully functional commercial corridor within months
  • The strategic development of Jhelum Road as the next flagship business boulevard
  • Integration with CBD 2 and surrounding mega infrastructure projects
  • Expansion of branded retail, banking zones, and modern commercial complexes
  • Investor-friendly installment plans for structured road commercial plots
   
This announcement positions Etihad Town Phase 3 not just as another commercial project, but as a carefully engineered business district aligned with Lahore’s future urban growth.
     

Final Thoughts

 
Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial offers a rare combination of:
 
  • Strategic location
  • Multi-road commercial planning
  • Proven development success
  • Affordable commercial entry points
  • Strong future connectivity
  • Institutional and branded interest
   
For investors seeking capital growth, business owners looking for prime exposure, and brands targeting Lahore’s expanding commercial zones, this project represents one of the most promising opportunities currently available.
   
As development progresses and infrastructure takes shape, Etihad Town Phase 3 is poised to become a landmark destination, where modern commerce, smart planning, and long-term value converge.
   

FAQs

   

What makes Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial plots a prime investment?

   
Strategic location on major roads, easy connectivity, upcoming CBD 2 & Nawaz Sharif Medical Complex, high visibility, and strong rental & capital appreciation.
     

Are there pre-launch payment plans available?

   
Yes, 3-year flexible pre-launch plans are available for general commercial plots, 300-ft Jhelum Road, and 150-ft Pine Avenue plots.
     

What types of businesses can operate here?

   
Retail shops, banks, corporate offices, food courts, showrooms, and high-rise buildings on major roads.
     

How soon will commercial development be completed?

   
Pine Avenue will be fully operational by March 2026; other roads like Jhelum Road are in rapid development.
     

How does Phase 3 stand out from other commercial projects?

   
Five major structure roads, small plots on installments, integrated lifestyle-commercial planning, and proximity to mega developments.
     
For complete payment plan details, booking options, and plot sizes, contact Etihad Marketing today.

posts.content:
Etihad Town has earned its reputation as one of Pakistan’s most trusted real estate developers, delivering high-quality, thoughtfully planned residential and commercial projects in Lahore. Building on this success, the brand is now taking its vision nationwide, planning strategic expansions into Islamabad, Karachi, and other emerging cities.
   
https://www.facebook.com/EtihadTown/videos/929305353100627/
   

Etihad Group

 
Etihad Town is one of Pakistan’s most trusted real estate developers, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality residential and commercial projects on time. Over the years, the group has built a reputation for modern infrastructure, strategic urban planning, and investor-focused developments, making it a preferred choice for both homeowners and investors.
 
The group’s success is rooted in its commitment to:
 
  • Timely Delivery: Every project is completed on schedule without compromising quality.
  • High Construction Standards: From modern architecture to durable materials, every development reflects excellence.
  • Thoughtful Planning: Residential and commercial communities are designed to maximize convenience, accessibility, and long-term growth potential.
  • Investor Confidence: Transparent processes, pre-launch options, and structured installment plans make investments secure and profitable.
     
 
Notable Projects Include:
 
  • Etihad Town Phase 1, Lahore: A master-planned residential community with modern amenities and structured roads.
  • Etihad Town Phase 2, Lahore: Expanding on the success of Phase 1, featuring integrated commercial zones and lifestyle facilities.
  • Etihad Town Phase 3, Lahore: The latest landmark project, serving as a blueprint for future national developments.
  • Etihad Garden, Rahim Yar Khan: A well-planned residential project catering to the city’s growing housing demand.
  • Etihad Town, Sialkot: A strategically located development combining modern infrastructure with community-oriented living.
 
This extensive portfolio showcases Etihad Town’s capability to deliver projects that blend quality, planning, and profitability. For investors, it demonstrates consistency and reliability; for residents, it guarantees thoughtfully designed communities with sustainable growth.
 
By combining past success with a vision for national expansion, Etihad Town continues to strengthen its position as a leading real estate developer in Pakistan.
     

Phase 3 Lahore: A Blueprint for Expansion

   
Etihad Town Phase 3 in Lahore exemplifies modern urban planning. Featuring well-structured residential communities, integrated commercial zones, business parks, and wide arterial roads, it serves as a model for future developments across Pakistan.
   

Key Highlights:

 
  • Multiple main boulevards & commercial roads
  • Business parks & vertical commercial avenues
  • Lifestyle amenities, including water park zones
  • Investor-friendly pre-launch & installment options
 
Phase 3 not only enhances Lahore’s real estate landscape but also lays the groundwork for Etihad Town’s broader national strategy.
    https://youtu.be/20TosfRCgO4  

Islamabad – A Planned Capital Presence

 

Etihad Town is planning to expand into Islamabad as part of its long-term growth strategy. As Pakistan’s capital city, Islamabad offers strong potential for well-planned residential and commercial communities due to rising population needs, infrastructure development, and increasing investor interest.

According to the brand’s future roadmap, proposed projects in Islamabad are expected to focus on:

 
  • Secure gated communities
  • Organized commercial districts
  • Sustainable development practices
  • Strategic locations near major road networks
       
This planned expansion reflects Etihad Town’s vision to replicate its Lahore development standards in other major cities across Pakistan.
     

Karachi – A Future Entry into Pakistan’s Largest Market

 
Karachi is another key city included in Etihad Town’s expansion plans. As Pakistan’s largest metropolitan and financial hub, the city presents long-term opportunities for both residential and commercial real estate development.
 
While operations are currently limited to Lahore, future projects in Karachi are expected to emphasize:
 
  • Planned communities in growing urban corridors
  • Modern commercial zones for retail and business activity
  • Infrastructure-focused development
  • Long-term investment value
       
Entering Karachi in the future would allow Etihad Town to diversify its portfolio and establish a presence in the country’s most dynamic property market.
   

Expansion into Emerging Non-Metro Cities

 
Beyond major metropolitan areas, Etihad Town also intends to explore opportunities in emerging cities where demand for structured housing and commercial projects is increasing.
 
These future developments are likely to include:
 
  • Master-planned residential communities
  • Small and mid-scale commercial zones
  • Affordable investment options
  • Modern infrastructure and utilities
       
 
By targeting such cities, Etihad Town aims to support balanced urban growth while offering early investment opportunities in developing markets.
     

Why This Expansion Matters for Investors

   
Etihad Town’s national growth strategy offers:
   
  • Consistent quality and planning across regions
  • Diversification across multiple real estate markets
  • Early access to pre-launch investment opportunities
  • Long-term capital appreciation
     
 
Phase 3 in Lahore proves the brand’s planning and commercial integration, which will be replicated nationwide.
   

A National Vision Built on Structured Growth

   
From Lahore to Islamabad, Karachi, and emerging cities, Etihad Town is redefining urban development in Pakistan. With a focus on structured growth, sustainable planning, and investor-oriented communities, the brand is evolving into a true national real estate leader.
     

Final Thoughts

   
Etihad Town’s expansion marks a defining moment in Pakistan’s real estate landscape. For investors, it offers growth, reliability, and diversification. For communities, it promises planned living, modern amenities, and sustainable development. From Lahore to the nation, Etihad Town is shaping the future of real estate.
     

FAQs

   

Why is Etihad Town expanding beyond Lahore?

To meet growing housing and commercial demand and establish a nationwide presence.
   

Which cities will Etihad Town enter next?

Islamabad, Karachi, and selected non-metro cities across Pakistan.
   

What types of projects will be launched in Islamabad and Karachi?

Planned residential communities with integrated commercial zones and modern infrastructure.
   

Why are emerging non-metro cities important?

They are fast-growing regions with increasing housing demand and limited planned communities.
   

How does Phase 3 support the expansion strategy?

It serves as a model project showcasing Etihad Town’s planning and development capabilities.
   

Is this expansion beneficial for investors?

Yes, it offers early investment opportunities, diversification, and long-term value growth.
   

Will future projects include commercial zones?

Absolutely, each city’s development will feature dedicated commercial areas and business districts.
   

Is Etihad Town becoming a national real estate brand?

Yes, the expansion positions Etihad Town as a developer operating across multiple regions of Pakistan.

Etihad Town has emerged as one of Pakistan’s fastest-growing real estate development brands, known for delivering well-planned communities, modern infrastructure, and high-value investment opportunities. Over the past few years, the developer has successfully built strong credibility by completing multiple residential and commercial phases on time while maintaining high construction standards.
 
As Pakistan’s real estate market continues to mature, Etihad Town is preparing for its most ambitious year yet. The year 2026 is set to become a landmark period in the company’s journey, with five new project deliveries, major commercial launches, and geographic expansion beyond Lahore.
 
This roadmap not only reflects Etihad Town’s growing confidence but also highlights new opportunities for investors, end-users, and business owners looking to secure premium real estate assets.
     

A Strong Start to 2026: Commercial Growth Takes the Lead

 
Etihad Town has officially announced that its first major launch of 2026 is:
     

Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial

 
This project has already attracted strong market attention due to its structured road network, prime accessibility, and flexible investment options. Designed as a multi-road commercial hub, Phase 3 Commercial introduces business plots on major boulevards including Pine Avenue and Jhelum Road, offering both small investors and corporate buyers a chance to enter premium commercial zones.
 
With pre-launch payment plans and growing interest from banks, brands, and retailers, this commercial phase is expected to become one of Lahore’s most active business corridors in the coming years.
     

First Delivery of 2026: Etihad Garden Phase 2

 
The first confirmed project delivery of the year will be:
   

Etihad Garden Phase 2

 
This project represents Etihad Town’s commitment to expanding affordable yet modern residential communities. Etihad Garden Phase 2 has been planned with essential urban infrastructure, including:
  • Proper road networks
  • Utilities and sewerage systems
  • Green spaces
  • Community facilities
  • Secure gated living
       
The delivery of this project will provide hundreds of families with possession-ready plots and homes while strengthening Etihad Town’s reputation for timely execution.
   

January 31 Delivery: Etihad Town Premier Enclave

 
One of the most anticipated milestones is scheduled for 31st January 2026:
 

Delivery of Etihad Town Premier Enclave

 
Premier Enclave is positioned as a premium residential segment within the Etihad Town portfolio. With modern town planning, upgraded amenities, and enhanced development standards, this enclave is expected to attract:
 
  • End-users seeking quality living
  • Overseas Pakistanis
  • Long-term investors looking for secure assets
       
This delivery marks a major confidence signal for the market and reinforces Etihad Town’s focus on structured expansion.
   

Expansion Beyond Lahore: Etihad Town Sialkot

 
Etihad Town’s growth is no longer limited to Lahore.
 
In 2026, the developer will also deliver:
 

Etihad Town Sialkot

 
This project represents a strategic move into one of Pakistan’s strongest industrial and export-driven cities. Sialkot’s economic strength, combined with modern housing demand, makes it an ideal location for residential and commercial development.
 
The project is expected to:
 
  • Introduce modern urban living standards to Sialkot
  • Offer new investment opportunities outside Lahore
  • Attract local business owners and overseas investors
       
 

Farmhouse Living: Etihad Town Sialkot Farmhouses

 
Alongside the main Sialkot project, Etihad Town will also deliver:
   

Etihad Town Sialkot Farmhouses

 
This development targets buyers seeking:
 
  • Spacious land holdings
  • Peaceful environments
  • Luxury countryside living
  • Weekend or second-home options
       
 
Farmhouse projects have seen rising demand in Pakistan due to changing lifestyle preferences, and Etihad Town aims to meet this demand with properly planned and legally structured farmhouse communities.
   

Completion of Remaining Blocks in Etihad Town Phase 2

  Another key commitment for 2026 is the completion and delivery of:    

Remaining blocks of Etihad Town Phase 2

 
This move will:
 
  • Increase overall population density in the community
  • Boost commercial activity
  • Enhance resale and rental values
  • Strengthen infrastructure utilization
       
 
It also reassures existing investors that the developer remains focused on completing previously launched phases before shifting fully to new projects.
     

Summary of Etihad Town’s 2026 Project Deliveries

 
Here is a quick overview of what to expect in 2026:
 
  • Launch of Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial
  • Delivery of Etihad Garden Phase 2
  • Delivery of Etihad Town Premier Enclave (31st January 2026)
  • Delivery of Etihad Town Sialkot
  • Delivery of Etihad Town Sialkot Farmhouses
  • Completion of remaining blocks in Etihad Town Phase 2
       
   

Why 2026 Is a Key Year for Investors

 
For investors, 2026 offers a rare combination of:
 
  • Multiple possession-ready projects
  • New commercial investment zones
  • Geographic diversification
  • Pre-launch pricing advantages
  • Increasing brand credibility
       
 
Whether the goal is short-term resale, rental income, or long-term asset growth, Etihad Town’s upcoming portfolio provides diversified entry points across residential, commercial, and farmhouse categories.
     

Final Thoughts

 
Etihad Town’s development roadmap for 2026 reflects a clear vision: structured growth, market expansion, and investor confidence. With multiple deliveries scheduled, a major commercial launch underway, and new cities entering its development network, the brand is positioning itself among Pakistan’s most reliable real estate developers.
 
For buyers and investors alike, staying connected with Etihad Town’s upcoming projects could be the key to securing early opportunities in high-potential locations.
     

FAQs 

 

1. What is Etihad Town’s first launch of 2026?

 
Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial is the first official launch of 2026, offering structured-road commercial plots and flexible payment plans.
   

2. Which project will be delivered first in 2026?

 
Etihad Garden Phase 2 will be the first project to be delivered in 2026.
   

3. When will Etihad Town Premier Enclave be delivered?

 
It is scheduled for delivery on 31st January 2026.
   

4. Is Etihad Town expanding outside Lahore in 2026?

 
Yes, Etihad Town Sialkot will be delivered as part of the 2026 expansion plan.
   

5. What is the Etihad Town Sialkot Farmhouses project?

 
It is a farmhouse community offering large plots for luxury and peaceful countryside living.
   

6. Will Etihad Town complete its older phases in 2026?

 
Yes, the remaining blocks of Etihad Town Phase 2 will be completed and delivered in 2026.
   

7. Are there commercial investment options in Etihad Town for small investors?

 
Yes, Phase 3 Commercial includes small commercial plots available on installment plans.
   

8. Why is 2026 important for Etihad Town investors?

 
Because multiple projects will be delivered, new launches will begin, and early investors can benefit from pre-launch pricing.
   

9. Is Etihad Town Phase 3 Commercial suitable for businesses?

 
Yes, it is designed for shops, offices, banks, and brands on major business roads.
   

10. How can investors get booking or payment plan details?

 
By contacting authorized dealers or Etihad Marketing for official updates and booking assistance.

posts.title: DHA Phase 9 Prism Basant Festival: Celebrating Spring, Culture, and Community Life
posts.excerpt: Basant Festival is one of Lahore’s most iconic cultural celebrations, symbolizing joy, renewal, and the arrival of spring. This year, DHA Phase 9 Prism proudly takes the lead in hosting and organizing a grand Basant Fest...
posts.content:
Basant Festival is one of Lahore’s most iconic cultural celebrations, symbolizing joy, renewal, and the arrival of spring. This year, DHA Phase 9 Prism proudly takes the lead in hosting and organizing a grand Basant Festival, offering residents a safe, vibrant, and well-managed environment to experience this cherished tradition.
   
Visitors can look forward to three days filled with colorful kites, lively music, traditional food, and unforgettable memories with family and friends.
   
DHA Phase 9 Prism will host the grand “DHA Basant Mela 2026” from 6th to 8th February 2026, a three-day mega celebration designed to revive Lahore’s most beloved spring festival in a safe, organized, and family-friendly environment.
   
By arranging this cultural event within the society, DHA Phase 9 Prism once again demonstrates its commitment to promoting not only modern living standards but also Pakistan’s rich heritage and strong community values.
     

Basant Festival – A Timeless Tradition of Lahore

   
Basant has long been associated with kite flying, colorful attire, traditional food, music, and social gatherings. For generations, Lahore has celebrated this festival as a symbol of happiness and unity.
   
However, in recent years, organized and secure celebrations have become essential. Recognizing this need, DHA Phase 9 Prism has stepped forward to revive Basant in a responsible, family-friendly, and well-structured manner, allowing residents to enjoy the tradition with peace of mind.
   
This celebration is even more special as it marks the revival of Basant in Lahore after nearly 25 years, restoring a cultural tradition that once defined the city’s identity worldwide.
     

DHA Phase 9 Prism as the Host and Organizer

   
Unlike informal celebrations, the Basant Festival at DHA Phase 9 Prism is:
   
  • Properly planned
  • Safely organized
  • Community-focused
  • Family-oriented
  • Environmentally conscious
       
 
The management and community teams have coordinated to ensure:
   
  • Designated kite-flying areas
  • Crowd management
  • Clean surroundings
  • Security arrangements
  • Smooth traffic flow
  • Emergency readiness
       
 
This professional approach highlights DHA Phase 9 Prism’s vision of combining cultural celebration with modern urban management.
     

DHA Basant Mela 2026 – Event Details

 
  • Location: DHA Phase 9 Prism, Lahore
  • Dates: 6–8 February 2026
  • Duration: 3 Days
  • Event Type: Cultural & Family Festival
       
   

 Ticket Information – Book via Ticketwala

   
To ensure a smooth and well-managed experience, entry to DHA Basant Mela 2026 at DHA Phase 9 Prism will be through official tickets. Visitors can conveniently purchase their tickets online from Ticketwala, the authorized ticketing partner for the event.
   
Booking in advance is highly recommended to avoid last-minute inconvenience and to secure entry for your preferred day. Ticketwala provides a simple, secure, and reliable platform, allowing attendees to confirm their participation in just a few clicks.
     

Event Highlights at DHA Phase 9 Prism Basant Festival

   

Organized Kite Flying Zones

 
Special areas are allocated for kite flying to ensure safety and enjoyment for both children and adults. The colorful skyline of Phase 9 Prism becomes a visual symbol of celebration and harmony.
   

Cultural Activities and Entertainment

 
Traditional music, local performances, and festive décor transform the society into a lively cultural space, showcasing Punjab’s heritage in a refined setting.
   

Family & Children Activities

 
Special attention is given to families, with kid-friendly areas and safe recreational spaces, reinforcing DHA Phase 9 Prism’s reputation as a family-oriented residential destination.
   

Kids Play & Family Zones

 
DHA Phase 9 Prism features specially designed kids play and family zones to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for children and parents alike. With fun activities, games, and supervised areas, families can relax and celebrate Basant with complete peace of mind.
   

Selfie Points & Event Décor

 
DHA Phase 9 Prism is beautifully decorated with vibrant cultural themes and dedicated selfie points that enhance the festive atmosphere. These creative backdrops provide perfect photo opportunities, making the celebration memorable and social-media friendly for visitors.
     

Why You Should Attend DHA Basant Mela 2026

 
  • Safe and organized kite-flying zones for everyone
  • Family-friendly entertainment and kids’ activities
  • Live music, cultural performances, and DJ nights
  • Delicious traditional food and festive treats
  • Vibrant selfie points and social-media friendly décor
  • Celebrate Punjab’s largest Basant Festival after 25 years
   

Strengthening Community Life Through Cultural Events

   
One of the key objectives behind organizing the Basant Festival is to strengthen community interaction within DHA Phase 9 Prism.
 
Such events:
 
  • Encourage neighbors to connect
  • Build trust and friendships
  • Promote cultural understanding
  • Create shared memories
  • Foster a strong sense of belonging
       
 
DHA Phase 9 Prism is not just developing plots and infrastructure, it is building a lifestyle centered around community harmony and social well-being.
     

Experience the Lifestyle of DHA Phase 9 Prism

 
Hosting large-scale cultural events significantly enhances the lifestyle appeal of any housing society. For residents, this reflects:
 
  • Active community management
  • High-quality living standards
  • Social engagement and cultural vibrancy
  • A long-term vision for a thriving community
       
 
The Basant Festival adds to the identity of DHA Phase 9 Prism as a progressive, culturally rich, and well-managed society, making it one of Lahore’s most attractive residential and social hubs.
     

A Model for Future Community Events

   
By successfully organizing Basant, DHA Phase 9 Prism sets an example for hosting future events such as:
 
  • National day celebrations
  • Sports festivals
  • Family carnivals
  • Cultural exhibitions
  • Seasonal gatherings
       
 
This initiative reflects a long-term commitment to transforming Phase 9 Prism into not only a residential project but a complete lifestyle community.
     

Conclusion: Where Culture Meets Modern Living

   
The DHA Phase 9 Prism Basant Festival stands as a beautiful example of how tradition and modern urban planning can coexist. By taking ownership of this iconic celebration, DHA Phase 9 Prism proves that cultural heritage, safety, and premium community living can go hand in hand.
 
Join the celebration. Fly kites. Enjoy the colors. Create memories that last a lifetime!
     

FAQS 

   

  1. What is DHA Basant Mela 2026?

 
DHA Basant Mela 2026 is a three-day cultural festival organized by DHA Phase 9 Prism to celebrate the revival of Basant in a safe and family-friendly environment.
     

  1. When and where will the Basant Festival take place?

 
The festival will be held from 6th to 8th February 2026 at DHA Phase 9 Prism, Lahore.
     

  1. Is the event suitable for families and children?

 
Yes, the event includes kids’ play zones, safe kite-flying areas, and family entertainment activities for all age groups.
     

  1. Will kite flying be allowed at the festival?

 
Yes, designated and controlled kite-flying zones will be available to ensure safety and enjoyment for everyone.
     

  1. Are there food stalls available at the event?

 
Yes, a variety of traditional and street food stalls will offer local snacks, sweets, and refreshing drinks.
     

  1. Will there be live music and cultural performances?

 
The festival will feature live music, cultural shows, and other performances throughout the three days.
     

  1. Is the event open to non-residents of DHA Phase 9 Prism?

 
Yes, visitors from across Lahore are welcome to attend and enjoy the Basant celebrations.
     

  1. What safety arrangements are in place for visitors?

 
The event will include security teams, crowd management, emergency support, and clearly marked activity zones.
     

  1. Are there facilities for taking photos and making social media content?

 
Yes, special selfie points and themed décor areas will be set up for memorable photos and videos.
     

  1. Why is this Basant Festival special for Lahore?

 
It marks the revival of Basant after nearly 25 years and brings back one of the city’s most beloved cultural traditions.
   
Planning to visit DHA Basant Mela 2026? 
Bring your family, fly kites, enjoy the colors of spring, and be part of a celebration that brings Lahore’s tradition back to life.

Tomorrow marks a long-awaited milestone for homeowners and investors as the Etihad Town Premier Enclave Possession Event 2026 officially takes place. Excitement is building across the real estate community, signaling the successful completion of another premium residential enclave in Lahore.
     

From Vision to Reality: Premier Enclave Comes to Life

 
Premier Enclave was designed as a modern, secure, and well-organized residential zone within Etihad Town. Tomorrow’s possession event confirms that the project has moved beyond planning and construction into real, livable reality, a moment every property owner eagerly awaits.
  https://youtu.be/Pape9gXP4tI  

What Makes Tomorrow’s Possession Event Special

Such events strengthen buyer confidence and set Etihad Town apart in Lahore’s competitive real estate market.

This milestone reinforces Etihad Town’s reputation as a trusted and reliable name in Pakistan’s real estate sector.

With possession being granted tomorrow, the enclave officially enters its next phase, where lifestyle, community living, and property value appreciation move forward together.
     

A New Chapter Begins Tomorrow

 
The Etihad Town Premier Enclave Possession Event 2026 is more than a date on the calendar, it is the moment where investments turn into assets and dreams turn into addresses. Premier Enclave will stand as another successful chapter in Etihad Town’s development journey.
 
For homeowners, investors, and the real estate market alike, tomorrow is truly about turning keys into new beginnings.

The possession event is scheduled for tomorrow at 1:00 PM at the Premier Enclave project site. Homeowners and investors will receive their official possession documents on-site.

All registered plot owners, investors, and invited guests are welcome. The event is organized to ensure a smooth experience while celebrating homeownership.

Owners will receive official possession documents to their plots, marking the transition from investment to actual ownership.
   

Is there an on-ground team to assist attendees?

Yes, Etihad Town’s management and project representatives will be present to guide attendees, answer queries, and introduce community features.

Possession confirms timely project delivery and investment reliability, increasing both resale and rental potential for properties in Premier Enclave.

posts.content:
Pine Avenue has rapidly positioned itself as one of Lahore’s most desirable commercial destinations. Located within the expanding Etihad Town development, this modern boulevard is attracting retailers, corporate brands, investors, and entrepreneurs who are searching for visibility, growth, and long-term stability. More than just a road, Pine Avenue represents a shift in how commercial zones are being planned and utilized in the city.
 
Below are the key reasons why businesses are increasingly moving toward Pine Avenue commercial spaces.
  https://youtu.be/35Nx2mm591Q  

A Business Address That Works Like a Magnet

 
For any commercial venture, location determines success. Pine Avenue benefits from direct connectivity to Khayaban-e-Jinnah, Ferozepur Road, Raiwind Road, and Lahore Ring Road, making it easily accessible from all major parts of the city.
 
Its wide 150-foot boulevard design ensures smooth traffic flow, better frontage, and uninterrupted visibility for shops and offices. This natural exposure acts as free marketing for businesses, helping brands stand out without excessive advertising costs.
  https://youtu.be/TECwFk5zm0k  

Designed for Today’s Businesses, Built for Tomorrow

 
Unlike congested commercial markets developed decades ago, Pine Avenue has been planned with modern business needs in mind. Underground utilities, organized commercial blocks, wide sidewalks, and landscaped surroundings contribute to a clean and professional environment.
 
This infrastructure is not just visually appealing; it directly impacts productivity. Reliable power systems, structured layouts, and reduced congestion allow businesses to operate efficiently while offering customers a comfortable experience.
  https://youtu.be/g_Asj9LNcqw  

Where Residential Growth Turns Into Daily Customers

 
One of Pine Avenue’s biggest strengths is its surrounding population. Large residential communities such as Etihad Town Phase 2 & 3, Valencia Town, Lake City, and nearby housing societies generate constant movement throughout the day.
 
This built-in customer base gives businesses an immediate advantage. Restaurants enjoy steady diners, retail stores benefit from regular shoppers, and service providers gain long-term local clients without heavy promotional spending.
  https://youtu.be/4LeTLZEeCEY  

Commercial Plots That Fit Every Business Vision

 
Pine Avenue offers flexible plot sizes, commonly ranging from 4 Marla to 8 Marla, making it suitable for:
 
  • Brand outlets
  • Corporate offices
  • Medical and dental clinics
  • Showrooms
  • Cafés and restaurants
  • IT firms and startups
     
 
Developers also provide convenient installment plans spread over several years, allowing small and medium businesses to enter prime commercial real estate without heavy upfront investment.
  https://youtu.be/IeWicbVLBU0  

A Market Where Property Works for You

 
Beyond business operations, Pine Avenue is proving to be a smart financial asset. Commercial property prices in this corridor have shown consistent appreciation due to increasing demand and limited premium inventory.
 
Since the project is LDA-approved, investors enjoy legal security along with strong rental demand. Many buyers are already earning passive income by leasing their shops and offices to established brands.
 
For long-term investors, Pine Avenue offers a combination of capital growth and rental stability rarely found in newly developed areas.
   

A Commercial Culture That Attracts Big Brands

 
Well-planned commercial zones naturally attract quality businesses. Pine Avenue is gradually forming a professional ecosystem where national and local brands coexist with service providers and corporate offices.
 
This diversity strengthens the area’s reputation and increases customer confidence. When consumers see organized commercial activity and recognized businesses, it builds trust and encourages repeat visits, benefiting every enterprise operating nearby.
  https://youtu.be/YjYITRmdW3g  

Why Pine Avenue Is Becoming a Long-Term Business Hub

 
Pine Avenue is not a short-term trend. Its development reflects Lahore’s southward expansion and the city’s growing demand for organized, modern commercial spaces.
 
With increasing traffic flow, rising residential density, strong infrastructure, and investor confidence, this corridor is evolving into a permanent commercial landmark rather than a temporary hotspot.
  https://youtu.be/kOh5wdNNkiY  

Final Thoughts

 
Choosing Pine Avenue commercial spaces is no longer just about buying property, it is about securing a strategic business future. From unmatched connectivity and modern infrastructure to consistent customer flow and strong investment returns, this location offers advantages that few new commercial zones can match.
 
For businesses seeking stability, visibility, and sustainable growth, Pine Avenue stands out as one of Lahore’s most promising commercial addresses.
  https://youtu.be/yrfF2NB7wNk  

FAQs 

   

What makes Pine Avenue commercial spaces ideal for businesses?

 
Pine Avenue combines strategic location, high visibility, and modern infrastructure, ensuring consistent footfall and growth potential for businesses of all sizes.
   

Which plot sizes are available on Pine Avenue?

 
Plots typically range from 4 Marla to 8 Marla, suitable for offices, retail outlets, showrooms, and service-based businesses.
   

Are Pine Avenue commercial plots LDA-approved?

 
Yes, all plots on Pine Avenue are fully approved by the Lahore Development Authority, ensuring legal security and investment reliability.
   

What types of businesses can operate here?

 
From corporate offices, clinics, and branded stores to restaurants, cafés, and startups, Pine Avenue accommodates diverse business models.
   

Is traffic managed efficiently within Pine Avenue?

Yes, Pine Avenue features organized visitor circulation areas, supporting smooth traffic flow and enhanced customer convenience.
   

How accessible is Pine Avenue from major Lahore roads?

 
Pine Avenue connects seamlessly with Ferozepur Road, Raiwind Road, Khayaban-e-Jinnah, and Lahore Ring Road, making it highly accessible for both customers and employees.
   

Are installment plans available for purchasing plots?

 
Yes, developers offer flexible payment plans spread over 2–3 years, making prime commercial spaces affordable for startups and SMEs.
   

What is the expected ROI for investors?

 
Due to high demand, strategic location, and growing commercial activity, Pine Avenue plots offer strong capital appreciation and rental income potential.
 

How does surrounding residential growth impact businesses?

 
Nearby residential communities provide a built-in customer base, ensuring steady footfall for retail shops, cafés, and service providers.
   

Is Pine Avenue suitable for long-term business expansion?

 
Absolutely, with modern infrastructure, rising property values, and a growing commercial ecosystem, it is ideal for sustainable, long-term growth.

From consultation to final purchase, we ensure a smooth and hassle-free process.

posts.content:
Etihad Town has long been recognized as a trailblazer in Pakistan’s real estate sector, delivering thoughtfully planned residential and commercial communities in Lahore. With a proven track record of on-time delivery, modern infrastructure, and investor-focused developments, the brand has consistently set new benchmarks for quality and trust.
   
Now, Etihad Town is taking its vision beyond Lahore, expanding into Islamabad, Karachi, and other emerging cities across Pakistan, a move that promises new opportunities for investors, homebuyers, and business owners alike.
    https://www.facebook.com/EtihadTown/videos/929305353100627/    

Etihad Town Islamabad Chapter: Bringing Premium Developments to the Capital

   
The Islamabad chapter marks the brand’s first step toward national expansion. Strategically planned, it will focus on:
   
  • Prime residential and commercial plots
  • Modern community amenities and infrastructure
  • Easy access to major city arteries and Islamabad’s business hubs
  • Investment opportunities for both end-users and commercial buyers
     
 
This chapter reflects Etihad Town’s philosophy of delivering value, modernity, and sustainability, now tailored for the capital city. Investors can expect the same level of quality and transparency that Etihad Town is known for in Lahore.
     

Karachi Chapter: The Next Frontier for Etihad Town

   
Following Islamabad, Etihad Town will launch its Karachi chapter, targeting one of Pakistan’s most dynamic real estate markets. Key features of this expansion include:
 
  • High-potential residential and commercial projects
  • Structured road layouts with integrated commercial zones
  • Connectivity to main city roads and business districts
  • Opportunities for early investment at pre-launch prices
       
Karachi’s vast population and growing urban infrastructure make it an ideal location for Etihad Town to replicate its successful development model, providing premium living spaces and profitable commercial plots.
  https://youtu.be/20TosfRCgO4  

Expansion into Non-Metro Cities: Unlocking Untapped Potential

   
Etihad Town’s vision goes beyond major metros, with plans to expand into emerging cities across Pakistan. These non-metro expansions will focus on:
 
  • Affordable, high-value residential communities
  • Smart commercial zones for small and medium businesses
  • Integrated amenities such as schools, parks, and retail areas
  • Investor-friendly projects with flexible installment plans
     
 
By entering these growing cities, Etihad Town is opening doors to new markets, making quality real estate accessible and profitable for both local and nationwide investors.
     

Why Investors Should Take Note

 
Expanding into multiple cities offers a unique opportunity for real estate investors. Key benefits include:
 
  • Early-stage investment advantages with higher returns
  • Access to prime locations in developing areas
  • Etihad Town’s reputation and reliability as a proven developer
  • Comprehensive community planning with modern infrastructure
  • Opportunities across residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects
       
With structured payment plans and strategic project locations, investors can secure profitable, long-term assets in both metro and emerging markets.
     

Behind the Vision – Etihad Town’s Strategic Growth Approach

   
Etihad Town’s expansion is not random, it’s a carefully strategized growth plan based on research, demand analysis, and urban development trends. Key pillars include:
 
  • Selecting high-potential locations in Islamabad, Karachi, and non-metro cities
  • Offering commercial and residential projects that cater to investor and community needs

posts.title: Everything You Need to Know About DHA Phase 10 Lahore: Plots, Prices, Booking & Investment Guide
posts.excerpt: DHA Lahore, officially known as Defence Housing Authority Lahore, is one of Pakistan’s most prestigious and well-planned residential communities. Renowned for its modern infrastructure, high security, and premium lifesty...
posts.content:
DHA Lahore, officially known as Defence Housing Authority Lahore, is one of Pakistan’s most prestigious and well-planned residential communities. Renowned for its modern infrastructure, high security, and premium lifestyle, DHA Lahore consistently attracts investors, homebuyers, and expatriates seeking a reliable and upscale living environment.
 
With several successful phases already completed, DHA continues to expand in Lahore, and DHA Phase 10 is the newest and most promising addition. If you’re planning to invest in Lahore’s most prestigious housing society, DHA Phase 10 offers unmatched lifestyle and growth potential. This blog covers everything you need to know from its history to project details, amenities, investment potential, and why it stands out among Lahore’s housing projects.
   
DHA Phase 10 FAQS Session 
   

A Brief History of DHA Lahore

 
Established in the early 1970s, DHA Lahore was envisioned as a secure, organized, and modern urban community. Over the decades, it has evolved into one of the city’s most sought-after residential areas, expanding in phases to meet growing demand for quality housing.
 
  • Phase 1–5: Focused on developing well-planned residential blocks with essential amenities, attracting families with strategic locations and enhanced security.
     
  • Phase 6–9: Marked DHA’s expansion toward suburban Lahore, offering larger plots, modern infrastructure, and improved community planning. These phases also introduced commercial areas, parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, creating self-sufficient neighborhoods.
     
  • Success and Response: Every DHA phase has received enthusiastic responses from buyers and investors. Property values in earlier phases have appreciated significantly, reflecting DHA’s credibility and reliability.
     
    https://youtu.be/fh9xkXiqA9U    

Introducing DHA Phase 10 Lahore

 
DHA Phase 10 is the latest addition to DHA Lahore. Strategically located, it blends modern urban living with a serene and spacious environment, away from the hustle and bustle of central Lahore.
 

Location and Accessibility

 
  • Prime Location: Situated near Raiwind Road, DHA Phase 10 offers easy access to Ferozepur Road, Lahore Ring Road, and other major routes.
  • Nearby Landmarks: Shopping centers, hospitals, schools, and recreational areas are all within reach.
       

Connectivity Highlights:

 
  • Bedian Road Access: Smooth connection to older DHA phases and major employment hubs.
  • Ferozepur Road Access: Easy approach to central Lahore and the Metro Bus network.
  • Future Ring Road Interchanges: Planned connections will enhance city-wide mobility.
  • Proximity to Airport: About 15 minutes from Allama Iqbal International Airport, ideal for frequent travelers and overseas Pakistanis.
     
  https://youtu.be/Kol1X0U_GB8      

Master Plan and Development

 
DHA Phase 10 is designed with modern urban planning principles, offering a mix of residential and commercial plots. The layout emphasizes a self-contained community with wide roads, green spaces, and top-notch infrastructure.
 
  • Residential Plots: Available from 5 marla to 2 kanal, catering to different budgets and preferences.
  • Commercial Areas: Designated zones support shops, offices, and retail spaces within the community.
  • Community Planning: Parks, jogging tracks, mosques, schools, and hospitals are integrated for convenience and a high standard of living.
       
   

Plot Categories in DHA Phase 10

 
DHA Phase 10 offers a range of residential and commercial plots, catering to investors, builders, and homebuyers alike. Whether you are looking for a cozy family home or a commercial investment, DHA Phase 10 has options to suit different needs and budgets.
 

Residential Plot Sizes

 
  • 5 Marla
  • 8 Marla
  • 10 Marla
  • 1 Kanal
     

Commercial Plot Sizes

 
  • 4 Marla Commercial
  • 8 Marla Commercial
       
https://youtube.com/shorts/o5q3ojk6nzk        

DHA Phase 10 Payment Plan

 
To make property ownership accessible, DHA Phase 10 offers an easy and investor-friendly installment plan. This plan is designed for both small and large investors, enabling them to invest without heavy upfront payments.
 

Payment Plan Highlights:

 
  • 10% Down Payment at the time of application
  • Installments Spread Over 4 Years
  • Flexible Options: Quarterly or half-yearly installments
  • Affordable Entry: Suitable for a wide range of investors
   

Development Phases of DHA Phase X

The development of DHA Phase 10 is planned to progress in multiple stages over the coming years:
 
  • 2025–2027: Master planning, land preparation, and initial infrastructure development.
  • 2027–2031: Construction of residential sectors, parks, schools, and community amenities.
  • Post-2031: Establishment of commercial areas, high-tech districts, and full-scale community services.
       

Key Features and Amenities

 
Key features of DHA Phase 10 include:
 
  • 24/7 Security: Gated entry, CCTV surveillance, and regular patrolling.
  • Wide Roads and Infrastructure: Designed for smooth traffic flow.
  • Green Spaces and Parks: Ample areas for leisure and community engagement.
  • Educational Institutions: Planned reputable schools and colleges.
  • Healthcare Facilities: Nearby hospitals and clinics for quality medical care.
  • Utilities and Services: Underground electricity, modern drainage, clean water, and proper sewage management.
       
   

Investment Potential of DHA Phase 10 

 
DHA Phase 10 offers multiple investment advantages:
 
  • High Returns: DHA properties have historically appreciated, making Phase 10 a strong investment.
  • Strong Demand: DHA’s reputation ensures high demand and excellent resale potential.
  • Growing Infrastructure: Development of roads, commercial hubs, and amenities is expected to further enhance property value.
       
   

What Makes DHA Phase 10 Stand Out

 
  • Modern Urban Planning: Wide streets, green zones, and clear zoning ensure a superior living experience.
  • Strategic Location: Excellent connectivity to central Lahore and emerging growth corridors.
  • Safety and Lifestyle: Strict security protocols combined with premium amenities.
  • Long-Term Value: Historically, DHA properties show consistent appreciation, making Phase 10 a smart choice for both homeowners and investors.
       
   

Who Should Consider Buying

 
  • Families: Seeking a secure and convenient community with schools, parks, and healthcare.
  • Investors: Looking for high returns and long-term value.
  • Professionals: Preferring a serene yet well-connected living space.
  • Business Owners: Interested in commercial plots for offices, shops, or retail ventures.
       
   

DHA Phase 10 Installment Plan – Flexible and Buyer-Friendly

 
The installment plan makes property ownership accessible:
 
  • Down Payment: Just 10% of the plot price at the time of application.
  • Remaining Balance: Paid over four years (48 months) in equal quarterly installments.
  • Payment Channels: Accepted through major banks like MCB, HBL, Bank Alfalah, Askari Bank, and Meezan Bank.
       
This plan enables salaried professionals, business owners, and overseas Pakistanis to invest comfortably without heavy upfront costs.
   

Conclusion

 
DHA Phase 10 Lahore represents the next level of modern, upscale living. With a strategic location, thoughtfully designed master plan, premium amenities, and strong investment potential, it continues DHA’s legacy of high-quality residential communities.
 
Investing in DHA Phase 10 is more than buying property, it’s securing a lifestyle of comfort, luxury, and long-term value in one of Lahore’s most prestigious housing societies.
   

Frequently Asked Questions

   

Is DHA Phase 10 officially launched?

 
Yes, DHA has announced the pre-launch phase with a balloting-based payment plan, application schedule, and plot categories.
   

What types of plots are available?

 
Residential: 5, 8, 10 Marla, 1 Kanal
Commercial: 4 & 8 Marla
   

How does the booking process work?

 
Plots are allocated through a transparent balloting system. Applicants submit forms before the deadline, and plots are allotted via a fair draw.
   

What is the payment plan?

 
A 10% down payment is required at booking. The remaining balance can be paid over 4 years in quarterly or half-yearly installments.
   

What is the non-refundable processing fee?

 
The fee varies by plot size, starting from PKR 5,000 for 5 Marla residential plots and up to PKR 30,000 for 8 Marla commercial plots. It cannot be adjusted against the plot price.
   

Can overseas Pakistanis apply?

 
Yes, overseas Pakistanis are eligible, subject to DHA’s documentation and payment requirements.
   

Which banks accept payments for DHA Phase 10?

 
Authorized banks include MCB, Bank Alfalah, Askari Bank, HBL, and Meezan Bank.
   

Are plots a good investment?

 
Yes, DHA Phase 10 is considered a high-potential long-term investment due to early-stage pricing and DHA’s credible development track record.
   

Are commercial plots available on installments?

 
Yes, both residential and commercial plots follow the same 4-year installment framework.
   

Is possession given immediately after balloting?

 
No, possession will be granted after the completion of development milestones as per DHA’s timeline.
   

Can I sell my plot or file before possession?

 
Yes, plots or files can typically be transferred after balloting, subject to DHA rules and payment of applicable transfer fees.
   

What are DHA Lahore transfer expenses?

 
Transfer expenses include taxes, DHA transfer fee, and other government duties applicable during property ownership transfer.
   

Does the transfer fee differ by phase?

 
Yes, it varies depending on the phase, plot size, and property type.
   

Who should consider buying in DHA Phase 10?

 
Families, professionals, investors, and business owners seeking secure, convenient, and high-potential residential or commercial plots.
   

How can I stay updated on DHA Phase 10 news?

 
Follow DHA’s official website, social media channels, and authorized dealers like Etihad Marketing for the latest updates and announcements.
   

To book your DHA Phase 10 plot or get the latest updates, contact authorized dealers like Etihad Marketing today.

posts.content:
The Government of Pakistan has announced important updates to its Housing Finance Scheme 2026, popularly known as the Construction Package 2026. In continuation of the Ministry’s notifications and with the approvals of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) and the Federal Cabinet, key revisions have been made to the “Markup Subsidy and Risk Sharing Scheme for Affordable Housing Finance.” These changes aim to make home financing more accessible for first-time homebuyers, families, and investors across the country.   Under the revised scheme, financing is now available for houses up to 10 Marla and flats up to 1500 sq. ft., providing greater opportunities for citizens to own homes. At the same time, it supports the construction, banking, and real estate sectors, creating opportunities for the economy to grow. This guide will explain the updated scheme in simple terms, helping you understand how to benefit from these government-backed incentives step by step.       What Is the Housing Finance Scheme?     The Housing Finance Scheme is a government program that provides financial assistance to help people buy or build homes. It makes owning a home more feasible by offering:  
  • Low-interest loans
  • Bigger loan amounts
  • Government support in the form of subsidies and risk-sharing
  In 2026, the government revised several features to make the scheme more attractive for buyers, especially first-time homeowners.       Key Amendments in the Housing Finance Scheme     The updated scheme introduces larger loan limits, reduced markup, and more flexibility. Here’s a breakdown of the key changes:     Higher Loan Limits:  Buyers can now access loans up to PKR 10 million, a significant increase from the previous limit. This allows families to purchase larger homes or flats without struggling to arrange funds.     Expanded Property Size:  The scheme now covers houses up to 10 Marla (2720 sq. ft.) and flats up to 1500 sq. ft., allowing families to invest in more spacious homes.     Fixed Low Markup: The interest rate is now fixed at 5% for all loans under the scheme. Previously, rates were tiered (5% and 8%), which could be confusing. Now, monthly payments are predictable and easier to manage.     Bank Financing up to 90%: Banks can provide up to 90% of the property value as a loan. This means buyers only need to provide a small portion as down payment, making homeownership more accessible for people with limited savings.     Government Subsidy Support: The government has allocated PKR 321.96 billion for markup subsidy and risk-sharing for the first 50,000 housing units. This reduces the risk for both banks and buyers, encouraging more people to participate.       Revised and Unchanged Parameters of the Housing Scheme    
Sr Parameters  Previous Revised
1 Eligibility Criteria • First time homeowners citizens of Pakistan holding CNICs • Not owning any housing unit in their name No Change
2 Scope • Purchase of house/flat • Construction of house on already owned plot • Purchase of plot and construction of house No Change
3 size of housing  • House of up to 5 Marla • Flat / Apartment of up to 1360 sq. ft. area • House up to 10 Marlas/2720 Sq. ft • Flat up to 1500 sq ft
4 participating financial institutions  • All commercial banks, Islamic banks, MFBs and HBFCL Agreed as per ECC approval
5 Maximum Loan size • T1 = Up to PKR 2.0 Million • T2 = Above PKR 2.0 Million & up to PKR 3.5 Million • Up to PKR 10 Million
6 Maximum Loan Tenor • 20 years (subsidy for 10 years) No change
7 Bank Pricing • One Year KIBOR + 3% No change
8 Customer/end user fixed pricing • Tier 1: 5% • Tier 2: 8% Flat 5% (for both tiers)
9 Bank Charges • No processing cost • No prepayment penalty No change
10 Loan to Value (LTV) Ratio • 90:10 (90% loan & 10% equity) No change
11 Risk Coverage • 10% of the outstanding portfolio under the scheme on first loss basis No change
12 Scheme size • 50000 Housing Units in the 1st year • Estimated disbursement Rs 100 billion Total expected 500,000 Housing Units (HUs) in 4 years. • 50,000 HUs in the fiscal year 2025-26 • 100,000 HUs in 2nd fiscal year 2026-27 • 150,000 HUs in 3rd fiscal year 2027-28 • 200,000 HUs in the 4th year 2028-29
13 Subsidy Cost for GoP • Markup subsidy (PKR 61.98 billion) and Risk-sharing cost (PKR 10 billion) totaling PKR 71.98 billion For 1st 50,000 housing units financed till June 30, 2026. Total subsidy PKR 321.96 billion (Markup subsidy 281.96 billion and PKR 40 billion for Risk-sharing cost)
14 Implementing Agency • State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) • Pakistan Housing Authority-Foundation, Ministry of Housing and Works No change
  To ensure uniformity, interest on loans already disbursed at 8% will be adjusted to 5%.       Who Can Apply?     The scheme primarily targets first-time homeowners who are Pakistani citizens and do not already own a property. Eligible participants can:  
  • Purchase a new house or flat
  • Construct a house on an already owned plot
  • Buy a plot and build a home
  This ensures that the scheme reaches people who truly need financial assistance to become homeowners.       Why This Scheme Matters for Homebuyers     The revised policy makes home ownership more affordable and secure:   Reduced Financial Burden:  With fixed 5% markup and up to 90% financing, buyers can now manage monthly payments more effectively.     Greater Property Options:  Larger houses and flats give you flexibility to choose a property that suits your family’s needs.     Investment Potential:  Real estate prices often rise over time. With government-backed loans, buying property is safer and can be a smart long-term investment.       Impact on the Construction, Economy, and Real Estate Sectors     The Construction Package 2026 doesn’t just benefit buyers, it also boosts key sectors:     Construction Materials:  Cement and steel industries benefit from increased housing activity     Banking Sector: More loan applications increase revenue for banks and financial institutions     Real Estate Market: Developers and agents benefit from increased sales, and see heightened demand as more buyers are empowered to purchase homes.     By supporting multiple industries, the scheme strengthens the overall economy while making homes affordable.       How to Participate     Interested buyers can approach any participating bank or housing finance company, including:  
  • Commercial banks
  • Islamic banks
  • Microfinance banks (MFB)
  • Housing finance companies
  Loans that were previously disbursed at higher rates will also be adjusted to the new 5% markup, so everyone benefits from the updated policy.       Conclusion     The Pakistan Housing Finance Scheme 2026 is a game-changer for anyone planning to buy or build a home. With higher loans, lower interest rates, and strong government support, owning a home is now within reach for more Pakistanis than ever before.     Whether you are a first-time buyer, a family seeking a bigger home, or an investor looking for secure property options, this scheme opens up exciting opportunities. Take advantage of the updated policy today and turn your dream of owning a home into reality.       FAQs     What is the Pakistan Housing Finance Scheme 2026? Pakistan Housing Finance Scheme is a government program that provides low-cost loans to help first-time homeowners buy or build houses and flats.       Who is eligible for this scheme? Yes, the scheme covers construction on already owned plots as well as purchasing plots and building homes.       How much of the property cost can the bank finance? Banks provide up to 90% of the property value, with the buyer contributing only 10% equity.       What is the government subsidy for this scheme? What Is the Housing Finance Scheme?

  • Low-interest loans
  • Bigger loan amounts
  • Government support in the form of subsidies and risk-sharing
 
In 2026, the government revised several features to make the scheme more attractive for buyers, especially first-time homeowners.

The updated scheme introduces larger loan limits, reduced markup, and more flexibility. Here’s a breakdown of the key changes:

Expanded Property Size: 

The scheme now covers houses up to 10 Marla (2720 sq. ft.) and flats up to 1500 sq. ft., allowing families to invest in more spacious homes.

Bank Financing up to 90%:

Banks can provide up to 90% of the property value as a loan. This means buyers only need to provide a small portion as down payment, making homeownership more accessible for people with limited savings.
 

Government Subsidy Support:

The government has allocated PKR 321.96 billion for markup subsidy and risk-sharing for the first 50,000 housing units. This reduces the risk for both banks and buyers, encouraging more people to participate.
     

Revised and Unchanged Parameters of the Housing Scheme

   
Sr Parameters  Previous Revised

8 Customer/End User Fixed Pricing • Tier 1: 5% • Tier 2: 8% Flat 5% (for both tiers)

11 Risk Coverage • 10% of the outstanding portfolio under the scheme on first loss basis No change

14 Implementing Agency • State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) • Pakistan Housing Authority-Foundation, Ministry of Housing and Works No change
 
To ensure uniformity, interest on loans already disbursed at 8% will be adjusted to 5%.
     

Who Can Apply?

   
The scheme primarily targets first-time homeowners who are Pakistani citizens and do not already own a property. Eligible participants can:
 
  • Purchase a new house or flat
  • Construct a house on an already owned plot
  • Buy a plot and build a home
 
This ensures that the scheme reaches people who truly need financial assistance to become homeowners.

The revised policy makes home ownership more affordable and secure:
 

Reduced Financial Burden: 

With fixed 5% markup and up to 90% financing, buyers can now manage monthly payments more effectively.
 

Greater Property Options: 

Larger houses and flats give you flexibility to choose a property that suits your family’s needs.
 

Investment Potential: 

Real estate prices often rise over time. With government-backed loans, buying property is safer and can be a smart long-term investment.
     

Impact on the Construction, Economy, and Real Estate Sectors

   
The Construction Package 2026 doesn’t just benefit buyers, it also boosts key sectors:

Cement and steel industries benefit from increased housing activity.
 

Banking Sector:

More loan applications increase revenue for banks and financial institutions

Developers and agents benefit from increased sales, and see heightened demand as more buyers are empowered to purchase homes.

Interested buyers can approach any participating bank or housing finance company, including:

  • Housing finance companies
 
Loans that were previously disbursed at higher rates will also be adjusted to the new 5% markup, so everyone benefits from the updated policy.
